resources.string: RIFT was denied access to its application data in Documents and cannot start. Windows ransomware protection (Controlled folder access) may be blocking RIFT.

To allow RIFT to access Documents: 1. Open Windows Security → Virus & threat protection → Manage ransomware protection. 2. Select Allow an app through Controlled folder access and approve the permission prompt. 3. Select Add an allowed app → Recently blocked apps and allow the executable blocked when you started RIFT. If it is not listed, use Browse all apps to select the RIFT executable. 4. Quit RIFT using the button below, then start it again.
If Controlled folder access is off, check that your account can write to the RIFT folder in Documents and that other security software is not blocking RIFT.
